sloka: यावत् लोका धरिष्यन्ति तिष्ठन्ति एतानि सर्वशः ।यत् कृतानि सुराः सर्वे तत् अनुज्ञातुम् अर्हथ ॥१-६०-२९॥
transliteration: yāvat lokā dhariṣyanti tiṣṭhanti etāni sarvaśaḥ ।yat kṛtāni surāḥ sarve tat anujñātum arhatha ॥1-60-29॥

translations.english: Let this heaven be an eternal abode for Trisanku in his physical form All these stars created by me shall endure as long as the worlds survive. O gods it behoves of you to accord consent to this".
